key_terms.قَتَرَةٌ: Blackness, darkness, or shade of shame

ai.seo_question: What does 'blackness covering their faces' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase (often linked to Surah Al-Imran 3:106 or Surah Al-Baqarah 2:171 depending on the specific verse context of 'qatrah') signifies the spiritual stagnation and 'dust of neglect' that settles upon the hearts of those who reject the Ahl al-Bayt and divine truth. It illustrates how persistent disbelief leads to a tangible darkness that obscures their faces on the Day of Resurrection, serving as a visible mark of their inner spiritual decay.
